@cenbank has cautioned Nigerians to be wary of investments in cryptocurrencies.

The apex bank said that cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin, Ripples, Monero, Litecoin, Dogecoin and Onecoin, and exchanges such as NairaEx, were not licensed or regulated by it.
